'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]], [[Attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***Four people are killed and 20 others are injured in overnight [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] missile and [[drone warfare|drone strikes]] on residential areas in [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-aerial-attack-kyiv-kills-one-injures-10-officials-say-2025-10-25/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-zelenskyy-missile-ballistic-kyiv-4381b48b931d7ed32e44a6d671b97dd5 (AP)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Five [[Pakistan Army|soldiers]] and 25 gunmen are killed in a shootout between [[Kurram District|Kurram]] and [[North Waziristan District|North Waziristan]], in [[Pakistan]], [[Durand Line|at the border]] with [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/10/26/pakistan-says-five-soldiers-and-25-fighters-killed-in-afghan-border-clashes (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Two people are killed during two [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s against a car and a motorcycle in [[Harouf]] and Qlayleh, [[Lebanon]], bringing the death toll from the attacks since the past 48 hours to nine. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/10/25/live-un-says-1-5m-in-gaza-need-aid-israel-blocks-borders-despite-ceasefir?update=4058734 (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**Hurricane warnings are issued in [[Jamaica]], as forecasts indicate [[Hurricane Melissa]] will likely reach Category 4 on the [[Saffir-Simpson scale]], while rainfall estimates exceed {{cvt|30|in|cm}} across the country and in [[Haiti]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/10/25/weather/hurricane-melissa-storm-tracker-forecast-jamaica-haiti-climate (CNN)]
**Over 145,000 people are evacuated by [[Guantánamo Province]] officials ahead of Hurricane Melissa's potential impacts in eastern [[Cuba]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/weather/storms/tropical-storm-melissa-hurricane-updates-rcna239732 (NBC)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Afghanistan–Pakistan relations]]
**[[2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict]]
***[[Minister of Defence (Pakistan)|Pakistani defence minister]] [[Khawaja Asif]] says that if peace talks with the [[Taliban]] fail, [[Pakistan]] will declare an open war on [[Afghanistan]], as Pakistan accuses the Taliban of sheltering [[Pakistani Taliban|Pakistani militants]], which [[Kabul]] denies. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistan-defence-minister-warns-open-war-with-afghanistan-if-peace-talks-fail-2025-10-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Canada–United States trade relations]]
**[[2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico]]
***[[U.S.]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that he will raise [[Tariffs in the second Trump administration|U.S. tariffs]] on [[Canada]] by 10% in retaliation for an anti-tariff advertisement sponsored by the [[Government of Ontario|Ontario government]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/oct/25/trump-tariffs-canada-ronald-reagan (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Irish presidential election]]
**[[Independent politician (Ireland)|Independent]] candidate [[Catherine Connolly]] is declared winner of yesterday's election of the [[President of Ireland]], after [[Fine Gael]] candidate [[Heather Humphreys]] concedes the election during the initial tallying of the votes. [https://www.reuters.com/world/left-wing-connolly-set-win-irish-presidency-opponents-concede-2025-10-25/ (Reuters)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/oct/25/catherine-connolly-ireland-presidential-election-leftwing (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2025 Ivorian presidential election]]
**[[Ivorians]] vote to elect their [[List of heads of state of Ivory Coast|president]], as incumbent [[Alassane Ouattara]] seeks a fourth term. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/ivory-coast-votes-with-ouattaras-legacy-age-focus-2025-10-25/ (Reuters)] 
**Ouattara is re-elected with 89.7% of the vote. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/ivory-coast-president-ouattara-wins-re-election-provisional-results-say-2025-10-27/ (Reuters)]
*The [[United Nations Convention against Cybercrime]], also known as the Hanoi Convention, is signed in [[Hanoi]], [[Vietnam]], marking the first time a [[Charter of the United Nations|UN treaty]] signing ceremony took place in Vietnam and the first time a [[multilateral treaty]] is named after a Vietnamese location. [https://thediplomat.com/2025/10/hanoi-convention-vietnams-middle-power-moment/ (''The Diplomat'')] [https://www.unodc.org/unodc/cybercrime/convention/home.html (UNODC)]
